help_intro.message: META SEO Inspector provides a detailed overview of a web page's SEO information, allowing users to view and evaluate various key aspects that may affect its visibility on search engines. Just check the red (warnings) and blue (info) badges for hints. If you can't see them means that the page is OK. It is frequently used to quickly check if a page has no major issues after being edited and can provide advice on how to correct some, just click the yellow FIX IT buttons found in the SEO Check section.

help_intro2.message:
The Explore section instead reports data the can be useful while not related to explicit issues, but can be used to examine a site you do not know much about.
This section could also be used to download some page elements like the inline SVG, images or Videos.

intro_externalr.message:
External resources are page elements or scripts loaded from other locations and are usually used to add features or track site usage.
Remember to disable any ad-blocker to see the full list of resources, or navigate in incognoto mode.

intro_head.message:
Order the elements in the <head> section to improve the page loading performances.
Higher priority means that the element should be positioned above those with lower priority.
This report is still in BETA and will be improved further.

intro_headers.message:
Click the headers name to reveal them on the page.
If the element is actually not visible, nothing will happen.

intro_internalr.message: Internal resources are now recommended if the server is using HTTP/2 (aka h2) as requests are optimized in many ways and therefore the page loads faster.

intro_largeimages.message: Bigger images have more chances to appear in the images SERP pages.

intro_othermetadata.message:
In this section you can see all the unrecognized meta tags.
In most cases these are custom tags only useful to the website developers.

intro_rec.message:
This section is used to record the data of any page as you visit them, only for the selected sites.
The data is stored only locally in your browser, and you can download it at a later time.

intro_rhints.message:
A resource hint is a dns-prefetch, preconnect, prefetch, or prerender relationship that is used to indicate an origin or resource that should be connected to, or fetched, by the user agent.
They allow the optimization of the delivery of resources, reduce round trips, and fetch resources to deliver content faster while a user is browsing a page.

Keep in mind that prioritizing a particular action takes away browser resources from other actions. Thus, resource hints should be used thoughtfully and not for everything.

intro_structureddata.message:
Structured Data helps search engines better understand what the content of a page and allows users to see the value of a website before they visit via rich snippets.

It is coded using in-page markup on the page that the information applies to. The structured data on the page should describe the content of that page.

You should mark up your site’s pages using one of three supported formats:
• JSON-LD (recommended by Google)
• Microdata
• RDFa

tip_bad_head_tag.message: It could happen when the HEAD section contains non-metadata elements (e.g. DIV, SPAN, etc.)

tip_canonical_defined.message: A canonical LINK is defined. The page is protected against internally duplicated content.

tip_canonical_missing.message: A canonical LINK is missing. The page is not protected against internally duplicated content.

tip_canonical_multiple.message: This could be caused by CMS themes and plugins conflicts.

tip_canonical_relative_url.message: A canonical URL should always be an absolute URL (including https://) to avoid search engine interpretation errors.

tip_canonicaldifferent.message: It's not wrong in itself, it could be the author's will to exclude redundant pages.

tip_h1optimalsize.message: टैग की लंबाई को संतुलित करना महत्वपूर्ण है। संक्षिप्त टैग प्रभावशीलता बढ़ाते हैं, जबकि बहुत लंबे टैग उनकी शक्ति को कम कर देते हैं। ध्यान रखें कि यदि Google को आपके पेज का शीर्षक (Title) अपर्याप्त लगता है, तो वह इसकी जगह आपके H1 हेडिंग का उपयोग कर सकता है।

tip_headtag_above_primary.message: Elements in the head with the highest priority must be among the first.

tip_headtag_above_secondary.message: Tags with higher priority should be located before tags with lower priority.

tip_headtitleempty.message: The TITLE tag was left empty, or some script cancels its content.

tip_hreflang_canonical_conflict.message: The canonical URL points to a different language version. Each localized page must have a canonical pointing to itself to avoid de-indexing.

tip_hreflang_duplicate_code.message: Multiple alternate tags specify the same hreflang code.

tip_hreflang_invalid_syntax.message: Hreflang codes must follow BCP 47 (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'zh-Hant', or 'x-default'). Underscores or invalid codes are not accepted by search engines.

tip_hreflang_missing_self.message: Google requires each localized page to include a self-referencing hreflang tag pointing to its own URL.

tip_hreflang_missing_xdefault.message: An x-default hreflang tag is recommended as a fallback for unmatched languages or international users.

tip_hreflang_relative_url.message: Absolute URLs (including https://) should always be used for canonical and hreflang tags to prevent crawler ambiguity.

tip_html_lang.message: If a page doesn't specify a language for the HTML element, a screen reader assumes the page is in the default language.

tip_intresources_limit.message: Try to reduce the number of loaded resources by packing them together.

tip_missingh1tag.message: यह दस्तावेज़ की संरचना को अस्पष्ट बनाता है और SEO से जुड़ी समस्या बन सकता है।

tip_missingheadtitle.message: Use this tag to provide the title of the tab in the browser. It may affect search engine rankings and click-through-rate from the search results.

tip_missingthemecolor.message: The theme-color meta tag provides a way to propose a color that browsers should use to customize the display of the page or of the surrounding user interface, and can drastically increase the 'wow' factor of your website on mobile devices.

tip_missingviewport.message: Without the viewport meta tag it is not possible to correctly implement responsive design, and the First Input Delay (FID) could get lower scores.

tip_no_doctype.message: Page lacks the HTML doctype, thus triggering quirks-mode which can cause your page to render in unexpected ways.
